demand_analysis.narrative: Demand exhibits erratic behavior with CV=0.75 and 90.0% non-zero days. Significant upward trend detected (p=0.0095). Distribution is right-skewed, requiring robust buffer strategies.

lead_time_analysis.narrative: Lead time averages 2.51 days with unstable stability (CV=0.49). High variability (1.22 days std) requires conservative effective lead time of 3.73 days.

buffer_analysis.selection_rationale: Standard model selected for erratic demand with unstable lead times. Safety stock of 2098 units provides 95.0% service level. Robust estimate (2403) available as alternative. Current SAP setting (573) is significantly understated.

order_quantity.narrative: EOQ calculation yields 2240 units. Final order quantity of 2241 units meets MOQ requirement and respects capacity constraints.

inventory_policy.narrative: Recommended (R,Q) policy: Reorder at 4890 units, order 2241 units. Review every 3 days. Maximum inventory of 4339 units uses 24.5% of available capacity.

safety_lead_time.narrative: Safety lead time of 2.80 days recommended (current SAP: 3.3 days). Action: REDUCE. Lead time variance dominated by transport factors.

cost_analysis.narrative: Optimized policy reduces total annual cost from $27730.45 to $24304.80, saving $3425.65 (12.4%). Savings primarily from reducing order frequency from 327 to 84 orders per year.
